policy.gate_scope: A gate on a CONTRACT blocks work that CONSUMES the contract (any coder task, anything under the go_target), not work that produces knowledge the decision needs anyway. While tier0 is blocked_on_gate, every other context is READY-FOR-ANALYSIS: analyst behaviour extraction from pinned source, test-corpus mining into capture plans, RAW observed vector capture on an oracle-reaching fire, and the Tier-C gap audit may all proceed. Contract-shaped storage, Go code, and amending the gated DEC-n may not. An open gate must never mean an idle factory.

gates_pending.title: Ratify DEC-1 frozen adapter contract

Ratifying as drafted would freeze a precision-vs-scale ambiguity that provably changes payable amounts (189 of 560 grid configurations diverge across precisions; first money divergence at 18 installments / 18.5%/ principal 87,654,321). The shipped conformance vector does NOT discriminate between the two readings, so the corpus cannot currently detect this defect class.

Run the T4 retry (attempt 2 of 2) against T5's 9 required changes

Must the discriminating vector be captured BEFORE ratification? (T5 recommends yes; orchestrator concurs)
Does DayCountActualActual stay in the Run-1 contract domain while unvectored?
Accept allowFullTermForTranche as a pinned-false conformance obligation rather than a dead field
State the Mongolian tenant's actual rounding mode - unresolvable from source (properties default 6/HALF_EVEN, tests mock HALF_UP; production MoneyHelper.PRECISION=19 vs 12 mocked)

database.rule: PostgreSQL is the ONLY database for every environment: the Fineract reference oracle, the Go module, vector capture, shadow/differential runs and CI. Bring the oracle up with the postgresql compose profile only.
